name: Behind the Scenes
description: A relatable workday vignette — your mascot working, thinking, building, and celebrating tiny wins in a stylish workspace.

clips.prompt: {mascot_description} sits at a stylish modern desk with a laptop and warm desk lamp glow. Looks up from work, smiles, and waves at the camera. Cozy office aesthetic, soft cinematic lighting.
The mascot leans over the keyboard, typing quickly and confidently. Quick subtle camera push-in, focused expression, productive vibe.
The mascot leans back, places a hand on chin in a thoughtful pose, then a small lightbulb-shaped glow appears overhead. A clear 'aha!' moment.
The mascot stands up, gestures excitedly at a whiteboard or floating UI mockup beside the desk. Animated, passionate, creative-director energy.
The mascot fist-pumps in celebration, sits back down, and gives a satisfied smile to the camera. Warm and human moment, playful.
The mascot raises a coffee mug toward the camera in a friendly toast, smiles, and the camera slowly pulls back to reveal the cozy workspace. Polished, inviting outro.
